title: The Miners' Ghosts
text: Pale shapes still swing their picks at a seam of ore as they have for a hundred years, their blows faint as a memory. The seam glitters. One of them turns, lamp-eyed and courteous, and asks for help with the last stretch.

options.label: Take up a pick and help them finish, so they may finally rest.

outcomes.text: The seam opens. The ghosts lay down their picks for good, their lamps going out one by one in thanks.

options.label: Wait for them to break through, then take the ore; the dead have no use for it.

outcomes.text: You get the ore. All of them turn their lamp-eyes on you and do not look away, not even when you are gone.

options.label: The wisest asks them how they died, and what they know of these tunnels.

outcomes.text: A cave-in, they say. They show you where the next one will come, and the way around it.
